body: Rulings are posted on STORY-1728 (17:30). Acceptance 5 is dropped under ADR-72. The design additions are accepted with conditions: (a) an Early-handler no-store test; (b) Distributed is a migration seam only; (c) team_identity_write must be derived from the registry, with a parity test against main's is_write_command and identity classification (5b identity, which the reviewer verifies). Land strictly in order, #2727 -> #2730 -> #2751, each with its own attested PASS, in a C2 window after the current ship queue drains. Mark #2727 ready for review now; I'll queue its review. Reply when the condition (a) and (c) tests are on the stack.
subject: STORY-1728 rulings posted; mark #2727 ready
